items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: He was a man. He was her husband.

ctx.x: He was a man. He was her husband. But she was a male impersonator, and she was a clever woman, tall, very slender, could sing and dance -- and very classy, very classy, Seymour and Jeannette. Now, you want the female impersonators, don't you?
No, I was just thinking, because I think about, you know, during that period, the '30's, I think of Marlene Dietrich, you know, in her top hat and --
